correctness.rationale: A rigorous coordinate-mixing argument proves box structure, the two-way private-symbol lemma proves all shattering traces, singleton-class counting establishes the exact VC bound, and a complete induction with positive branch and two-query negative branch constructs depth k+1 online shattering for every alphabet profile. originality.rationale: Public-source comparisons separated known product-convexity from the stated exact shattering and adaptive complexity results. Two accessible relevant contemporary full texts and a product-subgraph VC paper were inspected, and multiple statement-focused research-record and literature queries disclosed no dominating result. Priority risk survives for alternative terminology (signed-literal conjunctions, unrestricted combinatorial rectangles) and an older unavailable full product-geometry PDF.

value.rationale: This is an all-parameter classification for a natural family of Cartesian product graphs, including an exact intrinsic criterion for every shattered support, a sharp online dimension with constructive depth certificates, a uniform one-level learning gap, and an exact maximum-support enumerator in the two-factor case. The structural private-coordinate obstruction clarifies why static and online complexity differ; degenerate boundary cases are classified.
